g.text: - Bass drum, rock tuned, 22" or 20" preferred.
- Snare drum, dry tuned or semi-muffled, no harmonics.
- Floor tom 16", tuned low (preferably, if not 14")
- 1 concert bass drum (as large as possible)
- Snare drum, dry tuned or semi-muffled, no harmonics.
- Floor tom 16", tuned low (preferably, if not 14")
